title: Spanish Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish made with saffron-infused rice, vegetables, and seafood, inspired by the flavors of the Valencia region.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced jalapeno and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the Spanish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the jumbo shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the Spanish rice and stir to combine with the sausage and shrimp.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the shredded Manchego cheese and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
